observed.main_issue: All seven current main images depict earlier models; the new candidate mechanism and actual local-host coupling lack dedicated main figures. The abstract still inventories multiple models rather than following one method and its decisive tests.

scientific_center_question: Can locally acquired evidence select useful actions and acquire corrective feedback after a hidden environmental change while its bodily carrier changes?
claim_boundary: The separated local-contact rule, hand-set EMA/last-contact host coupling and event/RLS controller are distinct implementations. Their results must not be combined into a single already-validated algorithm; a central innovation and sustained bodily adaptation remain unproven.
abstract_opening_candidate: Artificial life seeks to connect the organization of a body with adaptive behaviour. A central challenge is to turn past encounters into actions that remain useful when environmental relationships change. Here we investigate how locally acquired evidence can guide action while its material carrier moves, grows and dies.
abstract_followthrough: After field/problem, state the actual unified algorithm once it exists, its specific distinction from verified nearest work, then the key matched tests and failures. At present explicitly identify the distinct prototypes; do not call their collection a novel framework or force three contributions. Replace a catalogue of old precursor/inheritance/protection findings with only the constraint essential to the central claim.
